observations.classification: Current independent corroboration of original 774 RIG-ADMISSION03-F049 and 059 SEGOVB-L11-ANIME-GAUGE-VALIDATION-ORDER/q641; no new unique count.
observations.trace: Public u16 Millimeters and deserializable BreastplateDesign permit a raw gauge before validation. validate_breastplate validates profile then Anime using wall_thickness before checking the outer wall range 1–20. With otherwise valid default Anime values and gauge 32768, Anime compares lap_lift with gauge.0 * 2; the product exceeds u16. Overflow-check settings determine behavior before outer rejection. DeviceBreastplate calls validate_breastplate before its fitted stages.
observations.limits: Source reasoning only: no product call, debug/release execution, invalid mesh acceptance, physical impact or normal loader reachability claim. In unchecked wrapping the outer range still rejects this gauge; preserve DesignError and valid-gauge behavior when deciding the eventual repair.

observations.classification: Existing bounded 774 ADDITIONAL-051 and 059 READ-L11-427/q1814/1815/1818 source obligations; not a new defect count.
observations.trace: Fluting fields and FluteCount are publicly constructible/Serde values; public columns accepts base_segments. At zero the sole regular-grid division is 0/0 and comparisons discard that NaN, leaving only pattern-region samples for an otherwise valid pattern. Whether zero is supported or any actual caller provides it is unresolved. The inspected DeviceBracer path first validates design and then uses BracerDesign columns with fixed 32 base segments. For validated count <=64, before dedup/pop there are at most 33 regular points + 2 boundaries + 64×9 flute points = 611.
observations.limits: No supported zero-base caller, rendered defect, native GPU behavior, direct raw-pattern input, all chart constructors or output-cardinality acceptance is established. PlateChart has a distinct around-based caller and q3141 traces a helmet carrier; do not merge first contracts automatically.

observations.classification: Nonfinding and bounded newly read inverse-method context, no new issue.
observations.trace: Validation checks count, width, depth, spread, lower spread, start/end ordering and fade before end-start and fade*2, so those u16 operations are safe on the path reaching them. With validated finite controls, spread ≤0.85 and lower-spread ≥0.5 keep ordinary fan/unfan denominators bounded away from zero; u/v validity and all actual consumers remain separate.
observations.limits: Unfan 132–146 was outside old 774 and L11/L12 scopes; our full personal reads are new source evidence, not inherited credit. No shader execution, geometry rendering, or proof of invertibility for every floating point value.

observations.classification: Existing 059 L12-CLOSURE-BREASTPLATE-CATALOG-IDENTITY-OWNER/q2689 remains open, no new count.

observations.limits: Do not invent an identity or issue solely from String; connect actual catalog producer, persistence and receiving owner before deciding.

nonfindings: Permille means a scaled factor, not necessarily a probability: breastplate design ranges intentionally allow some values above 1000.
None fluting and Solid versus Anime payload are distinct intentional states. Do not force an optional mode into a single mandatory fluted form.
Raw serialized design is an authoring input; validate-before-use on the two inspected device paths is not proof that all deserialization or consumers are safe.
Source presets 130–206 were personally read but not rendered; no historical shape, supported-body or visual acceptance is inferred.
open_questions: What supported loader or editor ingress can supply an otherwise valid Anime recipe with out-of-range gauge, and what exact prior F049/q641 repair ownership applies?
Which public or internal PlateChart/columns callers permit zero or unbounded base segments, and what endpoint/topology policy applies?
Are canonical fluting validation and finite chart input preserved for every caller including helmet, limb and native WGSL paths?
Which actual catalog ID owner, provenance, serialization and geometry consumers define identity beyond nonempty?
What exact all-body, topology, clearance, visual and runtime outcomes follow after authorized validation? Those are not assessed here.
